ios.desc:
Mapin - Find the best places, nightlife, events and people in every city! Every city has hotspots, hidden parties, and cool people – but they’re hard to find! With Mapin, you’ll have the best way to explore your city in real-time.

• See what’s happening around you and never miss an upcoming event
• Discover happenings that represent live events and nightlife entertainment with people sharing their moments
• Photos and videos, offering an authentic insight into the here and now and showcase the real vibe of the event
• Discover live pins from the community on the map – nearby or across the world!
• Get the best way to see daily what is recommended and which happenings are currently live
• Host and promote your own happening and let people rate the live event
• You will be notified shortly before the happening start, never miss the best parties
• See what your friends are up to right now
• Connect with people near you, those who joined the happening or anywhere in the world who share your interests
• Engage in lively discussions and share recommendations through comments
• New locations with new events are added every week!

Contact and Feedback:
We welcome your feedback and suggestions. Contact us at: info@mapin.ch

• Terms of Service - https://www.mapin.social/terms
• Privacy Policy - https://www.mapin.social/privacy

Join us on this exciting journey and be among the first to explore the world through Mapin.
